nodesDescription: Open a shell on a Full-control node. Relay-only nodes do not accept browser terminals.
noFullNodes: No node is at Full control and online.
nodesUnavailable: Your nodes could not be loaded.
queuedDescription: An agent asked you to run these. Run opens a terminal with the command typed; you press Enter.
workspaceDescription: Terminal input and output are encrypted between this browser and the node. The server cannot read them or type into them.
workspaceEmpty: Open a terminal on a node, or run a queued command, and it appears here.

socket.closed: Not connected to the relay. Reconnecting…
socket.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again to use terminals.

exitedWithCode: The shell ended with exit code {{code}}.
approvalNeeded: Approve this terminal on the node: {{command}}
endFailed: The relay could not end this session. Try again.
typedCommandHint: The command is typed into the terminal. Check it, then press Enter to run it.
typedCommandNotTyped: This command has more than one line or characters other than plain ASCII, so it was not typed. Copy it from the queue and paste it into the terminal.
identityChangedDetail: This node's identity key changed (new fingerprint {{fingerprint}}). Trust it only if you reinstalled or re-enrolled the node.
trustFailed: The node's identity changed again. Check it before you trust it.

rejection.identity_changed: The node's identity key changed since you last connected.
rejection.identity_invalid: The node's identity could not be verified.
rejection.identity_mismatch: The node answered with a key its identity did not sign.
rejection.not_found: The node or terminal was not found.
rejection.not_granted: Browser terminals need the node at Full control.
rejection.unsupported: Browser terminals are not enabled on this node.
rejection.cli_too_old: Upgrade wsmp on this node to use browser terminals.
rejection.limit: Terminal limit reached. End a session and try again.
rejection.invalid: The relay refused this terminal request.
rejection.ticket_invalid: This terminal link expired or was already used. Open the terminal again.
rejection.bad_handshake: The secure handshake with the node failed.
rejection.step_detached: This terminal was disconnected. Open it again from Steps waiting for you.

steps.title: Steps waiting for you
steps.description: A runtime step that needs a person (for example a sudo password) runs in its own terminal on the node, also on Relay-only nodes. Check the command and who wrote it before you run it.
steps.loadFailed: Could not load the steps waiting for you.
steps.reopened: The step runs again in a fresh terminal.
steps.passwordNote: What you type in this terminal, a sudo password included, passes through this server and the page it serves. Press Enter in the terminal to run the command, or q to close it without running.
steps.waiting: Its terminal is open and waits for you.
steps.running: The command is running in its terminal.
steps.closed: The terminal closed without success. Run it again, or cancel the step.
steps.queued: Its terminal is opening on the node.

hold.operator_capability_missing: The node cannot open operator terminals right now (offline, or wsmp needs an update).
hold.operator_session_full: The node holds too many terminals; this one opens when one ends.
hold.operator_node_full: Four steps already wait on this node; this one opens when one of them ends.
hold.operator_terminals_disabled: The node could not open the terminal. Run it again once the node can.

refusal.not_interactive: This step does not run in a terminal.
refusal.not_waiting: This step no longer waits for you.
refusal.running: The command is already running in its terminal; it finishes there.
refusal.superseded: The runtime stopped or restarted since; this step no longer runs.
refusal.terminal_closed: The terminal closed. Run the step again to get a new one.
refusal.terminal_unavailable: The terminal is not open on the node yet, or the node is offline. Try again shortly.

steps.commandRendered: The command that runs, with its values filled in as the node fills them:
steps.nodeFills: The node fills in {{names}} itself, from its own address on the fabric. A node without such a value refuses the step.
steps.refused: The server expects the node to refuse this step (bad value: {{field}}), so nothing would run. Cancel it and fix the runtime.

unavailable.intent: This step's values cannot be read here, so its command is not shown.
unavailable.version: This step runs a different definition than the one this instance launched, so its command is not shown here.
unavailable.head_addr: The head node has no address on this step's fabric yet, so its command is not filled in.
unavailable.node_fill_ambiguous: This command contains text that looks like a value the node fills in but is not one, so it is not shown filled in here.

steps.unavailableHint: The terminal on the node shows the exact command before it runs.
steps.refusedButOpen: The server expected the node to refuse this step (bad value: {{field}}), yet its terminal opened, so the command cannot be confirmed here.
